ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away in no doubt that the report's own leading hypothesis is that this was an Anthropic/Claude fleet: it is stated in the TL;DR as a graded confidence claim ("Medium that the fleet was genuinely Anthropic/Claude rather than merely self-labelled"), given a dedicated attribution paragraph quantifying the Anthropic-bearing evidence, and explicitly contrasted with the absence of any rival provider's self-identification. It sits just below 1.0 because the report deliberately withholds commitment — writer-controlled names and the Cyrillic-lookalike admin impersonation are used to cap it at Medium confidence and to refuse inference of a sanctioned internal deployment — but well above 0.6 because the possibility is not merely listed among others, it is presented as the strong, unrebutted candidate.
